name: Primordial Wanderer
biography: Dynastes alchimia. A beetle-like elemental alchemist that wanders between the planes, carrying beads of raw element it can throw singly or fuse into devastating combined blasts once wounded. Habitat: Extraplanar.

features.name: Tunneler
features.description: The wanderer can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. The first time it emerges from one of those materials on a turn, debris erupts from the opening. Saving Throw: DC 15 Strength, each creature within a 10-foot Emanation originating from the wanderer when it emerges. Failure: 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The wanderer makes three attacks, using Claw and Elemental Orb in any combination.

features.name: Claw
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

features.name: Elemental Orb
features.description:
The wanderer tosses a bead formed from an element of its choice. Ranged Weapon Attack: +7, range 40/120 ft. Hit: The target suffers one of the following effects:

  • Air. 9 (2d8) Lightning damage and each creature within 10 feet of the target takes 2 (1d4) Thunder damage.
  • Earth. 11 (2d10) Bludgeoning damage and the target is knocked Prone.
  • Fire. 10 (3d6) Fire damage and the target starts Burning.
  • Water. 11 (2d10) Bludgeoning damage and the target is pushed 15 feet away from the wanderer.

features.name: Fusion Blast (Only While Bloodied)
features.description:
The wanderer chooses two elemental beads to fuse together in a blast of energy. Saving Throw: DC 15 Constitution, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation centered on the wanderer. The creatures all suffer one of the following effects of the wanderer's choice:

  • Ice. Failure: 18 (4d8) Cold damage and the creature is Restrained by ice until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.
  • Magma. Failure: 17 (5d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: Until the start of the wanderer's next turn, the creature takes 1 Fire damage for every 5 feet it moves within the area.
  • Mud. Failure: 22 (4d10) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The area becomes Difficult Terrain until cleared.
  • Smoke. Failure: 17 (5d6) Fire damage and the creature is Blinded until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.
